designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1964 as a migratory waterfowl refuge on restored Kootenai River floodplain.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Kootenai National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
FWS ServCat: Kootenai NWR CCP (established 1964; land approved Dec. 10, 1963)

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Established in 1964 as a migratory waterfowl refuge, Kootenai National Wildlife Refuge provides habitat for more than 220 species of birds, 45 species of mammals, and 22 species of fish.
